metadata.title: Convergence of metric measure spaces via embeddings in the Urysohn universal space
metadata.abstract: We study different notions of convergence of metric measure spaces by means of isometric embeddings into the Urysohn universal metric space $\mathbb U$. Due to the universality of $\mathbb U$, the collection $\mathbb X_1$ of isomorphism classes of normalised metric measure spaces can be canonically identified with the quotient (set) $\mathscr P_\sim(\mathbb U)=\mathscr P(\mathbb U)/\sim$ of the space $\mathscr P(\mathbb U)$ of Borel probability measures on $\mathbb U$, where $\mu\sim\nu$ if $\nu$ is the pushforward of $\mu$ under an isometry between their respective supports. By making crucial use of the ultrahomogeneity of $\mathbb U$, we show that, under the above identification, Gromov's box topology on $\mathbb X_1$ coincides with the quotient topology induced by the weak topology of $\mathscr P(\mathbb U)$. More quantitatively, the truncated $1$-Wasserstein distance on $\mathscr P(\mathbb U)$ induces a complete and separable distance ${\sf d}_{\rm mG}$ on $\mathbb X_1\cong\mathscr P_\sim(\mathbb U)$, which metrises the quotient topology of $\mathscr P_\sim(\mathbb U)$ and is Hölder equivalent to the box distance $\square$.

analysis.workSummary: 将归一化度量测度空间嵌入 Urysohn 普适空间，证明 Gromov box 拓扑等于概率测度弱拓扑的自然商拓扑。
analysis.breakthrough: 得到完备可分距离并与 box 距离 Hölder 等价。
analysis.limitations: 商等价按支撑上的等距推前定义，不是普通测度相等。 本条依据官方摘要整理，尚未核验正文证明；AI 披露以独立全文核查为准。
